definitions.gloss: line break, new line, new paragraph
definitions.explanation: Starting a new line in writing or text input. Used both for the act of breaking a line and for the line break character itself.

examples.japanese: ここで{改行|かいぎょう}してください。
examples.english: Please start a new line here.

examples.japanese: エンターキーを{押|お}すと{改行|かいぎょう}される。
examples.english: Pressing the Enter key creates a line break.

examples.japanese: {文章|ぶんしょう}が{読|よ}みにくいので、もう{少|すこ}し{改行|かいぎょう}を{入|い}れたほうがいい。
examples.english: The text is hard to read, so you should add more line breaks.

notes:
{改行|かいぎょう} is composed of {改|かい} (change, reform) + {行|ぎょう} (line, row).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改行|かいぎょう}する: to start a new line
- {改行|かいぎょう}を{入|い}れる: to insert a line break
- {改行|かいぎょう}コード: line break code (newline character)

USAGE: Commonly encountered in computing and word processing contexts, but also used for handwriting and printed text. In traditional Japanese writing ({縦書|たてが}き), {改行|かいぎょう} means starting a new vertical column.
